title: Blue Flag 2026-27: the International Blue Flag Jury certifies Ladghar and Guhagar (Ratnagiri) and Shrivardhan (Raigad), per Maharashtra's Environment and Climate Change Department (11 Nov 2026); season at the three beaches opens 15 Nov; 22 Indian beaches hold the Blue Flag for 2026-27 (13 renewed, 9 new); Oct 2025 announcement by minister Aditi Tatkare of five Maharashtra beaches noted (AIR); FEE checks: tested bathing water, lifeguards/rescue gear, toilets and waste
